'''2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks''' is a strategy article by [[Brandon Ruck]], posted to [[DeckTech]] under his handle '''Jabba_the_Ruck''' on 17 April 2007.<ref name="dt6497">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/articles/articles.php?id=6497&view=2 2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks], Brandon "Jabba_the_Ruck" Ruck, DeckTech (17 April 2007). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070509102452/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/articles/articles.php?id=6497&view=2&PHPSESSID=888f56ab12c12ca9e443054c5527044e Internet Archive]</ref> It describes 47 deck types available in April 2007, when the newest [[Players Committee]] virtual set was [[Virtual Set 12]]: 35 objective decks (18 Light Side and 17 Dark Side) and 12 decks built without an objective.<ref name="dt6497" /> It is the second edition of Ruck's '''1st Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks''', posted to DeckTech on 26 July 2005.<ref name="dt6210">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/articles/articles.php?id=6210&view=2 1st Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks], Brandon "Jabba_the_Ruck" Ruck, DeckTech (26 July 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070922002338/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/articles/articles.php?id=6210&view=2 Internet Archive]</ref>

The article is a guide to deck types, not a set of decklists: no entry gives a 60-card list.<ref name="dt6497" />

== Content ==

Ruck wrote that the first edition ran to 35,474 words on more than 45 printed DeckTech pages, and that the second edition was almost 80,000 words on 138 printed Word pages.<ref name="dt6497" /> Each objective entry gives the objective's game text, the popular cards to look for, the idea behind the objective, how it can win, what changed since the first edition, and why to play it or not. The entries for decks without an objective give starting locations in place of game text. The second edition added a nickname for each objective (such as CCT, MWYHL, Speeders and Walkers), set numbers next to virtual cards (for example "Luke Skywalker (V1)"), the "What Changed Since 1st Edition" section, and the non-objective decks.<ref name="dt6497" /> DeckTech readers rated the article 5.00.<ref name="dt6497" />

The objectives are listed in order of release, followed by the decks that start with [[Careful Planning (V)]] (Light Side) or [[Combat Readiness (V)]] (Dark Side).<ref name="dt6497" /> The article numbers two Light Side objectives 13.

== Document ==

A 64-page Microsoft Word copy of the article was shared in the Star Wars CCG files on BoardGameGeek. [[:File:2nd Annual SWCCG Encyclopedia of Decks.pdf]] is a PDF conversion of that copy. Its text matches the DeckTech article, with one reader comment added at the end.
